reason: hotslice/ is deployed as a Cloudflare Python Worker (worker/), and the newest Workers Python runtime is 3.14 (compat flag python_workers_314; workers-py 1.17.8 supports only 3.12-3.14, no 3.15 Pyodide build). Raising requires-python or ruff's target to 3.15 would admit 3.15-only code the Worker can't run. All dependencies install and the CLI builds on 3.15.
